teaser: Where to focus when agents can go in every direction: the place of highest leverage, shown on three days of real steps, two walked back and one parked.
core_idea: When agents can build in any direction the scarce thing is direction, and the rule is to work at the place of highest leverage, where the most value can be added now, nothing blocks, and you can start without knowing how the whole problem ends because each shipped step produces better tooling and a better view; the last three days show it, a meter to pay by depth to personas to sharing to a persona link to a reading list to a passkey design walked back and forward by a lab to real vaults and a vault pane, each shipped and used before the next was chosen, with a branch parked as valuable only with many readers; on a Wardley map the passkey work became a product in a day because its shoulders are mature commodities and the one custom layer sits where a provider is not; walking back and parking are not failures; constraints, saying no and shipping to a user who can be me; and the brief that could not be written until the art of the possible was known.

nodes.label: Direction is the scarce thing
nodes.summary: Agents can build in any direction; what to build next and when to stop is the job.

nodes.label: Places of highest leverage
nodes.summary: Where the most value can be added right now, nothing blocks, and you can start; a rule about where to stand, not what to build.

nodes.label: Start without knowing how it ends
nodes.summary: By the time you reach the hard part you have better tooling and a better view; the first step's job is to produce the second step's information.

nodes.label: Guess, measure, narrow
nodes.summary: Fermi estimates, Bayesian updating, Monte Carlo ranges: the first number is not the point, the range after a few steps is.

nodes.label: Constraints and saying no
nodes.summary: Tokens, hours, attention and focus are why it works; FIRE and knowing when to stop; saying no is most of the work with agents.

nodes.label: Three days, step by step
nodes.summary: Meter, pay by depth, personas, encrypted share, persona link, reading list, passkey design, the lab's correction, real vaults, the vault pane; each shipped and used before the next.

nodes.label: Walking back is a two-way door
nodes.summary: The door removed, then put back by a test, in twelve hours; cheap because the design was shipped as something you could press.

nodes.label: Parking is not failure
nodes.summary: The wire's scheduling parked with a dated reason, valuable only with many readers; the feedback loop on what exists is the leverage today.

nodes.label: The path only looks obvious backwards
nodes.summary: Five choices at every step forwards; the discipline that replaces foresight is shipping and using each step before choosing the next.

nodes.label: Which shoulders, on the map
nodes.summary: The passkey work became a product in a day because its stack is mature commodities; the custom layer sits where a provider, the QR path, is not.

nodes.label: Shipped, and used, even by me
nodes.summary: Nothing stays a hypothesis; a step that was used tells you where the next one is.

nodes.label: The brief depends on the possible
nodes.summary: The inbox brief could not be written until the vault ran; the art of the possible is what shipping leaves behind.

quotes.text: It is a rule about where, not what.
quotes.why: What the rule does and does not decide.

quotes.text: That is the discipline that replaces foresight.
quotes.why: Shipping and using each step before choosing the next.

quotes.text: Which shoulders you stand on decides how fast your piece becomes a product.
